source_selection.selection: ALL SCD validation images with exactly one carton annotation, excluding all 38 prior benchmark/screening IDs and any already downloaded filename. No replacement or outcome filtering.
source_selection.scope: Previously unused in this repository, not necessarily unseen in model training. Single-annotation convenience stratum, not warehouse accuracy. All selected images will be reported even if unsuitable for acceptance.

manifest.scope: 5 previously unused public SCD photos, 15 authored controls. Original images, no selected area. Synthetic audio and notes/orders. Existing full_checks workflow with exact product-description matching, supplier, object cross-check, receiver, second reader and audit. No structured brand/article/model identity in orders: this is NOT strict SKU validation. No ERP writer. Not independent shipments, model-training holdout or field accuracy.
manifest.protocol: Single first application run per case, no outcome-based changes or retries; existing provider SDK transport retries remain enabled. Every selected image and case retained, including errors. Quantity mismatch changes note and open order to 2; speech remains 1. Receiver uncertainty changes only speech. Earlier gate rules can mask injected faults. No measured worker baseline or total billing cost.
